criteria.dual_mode:
Run Bun.markdown.html alongside render and splice
positions back into the safe tree.
criteria.normalize_soft:
Emit every in-paragraph newline as plain newline text; hard breaks lose their
.
criteria.reject_hard: Pre-scan source for hard-break syntax (two trailing spaces, backslash newline) and reject such documents with markdown::rejected_break.

break_policy.instructions:
Render mode cannot distinguish soft wraps from hard breaks (both arrive as newlines); html mode prints
for hard breaks only. How should the safe renderer handle line breaks?

criteria.allow_all_native: Pass through whatever Bun emits, including http and mailto: with autolinks on; loosen the html.ts URL policy to match native behavior.
criteria.allow_fragments: Strict policy plus #fragment hrefs and heading self-links (headings autolink on); extend parseURL to accept same-document fragments.
criteria.strict_https_local: Allow https and local / only; keep autolinks and heading self-links off; reject http, mailto:, and fragment hrefs as markdown::unsupported_url.

link_scope.instructions: Which href policy should the safe renderer enforce, knowing html.ts admits only https and local / URLs while Bun can mint http (www autolinks), mailto:, and #fragment hrefs?

criteria.drop_details: Render list/table structure but silently discard align and start values; columns unaligned, ordered numbering restarts at 1.
criteria.full_fidelity: Extend html.ts (align on th/td limited to left/center/right; integer start on ol) and render every carried detail, synthesizing disabled checkbox inputs for task items.
criteria.subset_reject: Refuse documents containing aligned columns, non-1 ordered starts, or task items with a loud markdown::unsupported_construct failure.

table_list_fidelity.instructions: Which fidelity rule should govern Markdown lists, task items, and tables whose details the html.ts gate cannot express today (cell align, ordered start)?

state:
Can compiles to TypeScript executed on pinned Bun 1.4.2. B1-12 renders Markdown to HTML through Bun.markdown.render with typed callbacks, plus a G-HTML gate: renderer output must satisfy runtime/platform/html.ts element checks before renderSafe releases it. Measured probe ledger on the pinned build: render fires list/listItem with {index,depth,ordered,start?,checked?} and table/thead/tbody/tr/th/td with th/td meta align left|center|right|absent; task items surface checked booleans while html mode emits ; nested lists report depth 0/1/2 and ordered start survives (start="5" in html mode); soft and hard breaks both arrive as a bare newline inside paragraph children in render mode although html mode emits
for hard breaks only; code callbacks receive {language} for fenced blocks (case preserved) and no meta for indented blocks, with a trailing newline in children; heading meta carries {level,id} under headings:{ids:true} with slug hello-world for 'Hello World!'; raw HTML passes through html mode verbatim, tagFilter only rewrites < of blocked tags (<script>alert(1)</script>), and noHtmlBlocks/noHtmlSpans reroute raw markup into plain text callbacks; wikiLinks:true silently discards link targets in render mode while html mode emits ; underline:true and latexMath:true are ignored by this build (__x__ still , $x$ literal); autolinks:true prefixes www hosts with http:// and wraps emails as mailto: links; headings:true adds id plus a self link ; NUL bytes surface as U+FFFD; strikethrough renders ; fenced js blocks serialize . html.ts bounds: parseURL admits only https and local / paths (http, mailto:, #fragment, #hello rejected); authorTags holds the table family, del, input, br, hr but no u/s; globals admit id/class/title; applicability lacks align and start. Settled: fixed standaloneBytes ceilings, no caller limit options; raw markup degrades to visible escaped text via the noHtml flags.
